literal: "She grew pale", saying except, her abandoned he, those who say are not.
translation: People only say, "She has grown pale," but no one says, "He abandoned her."
modern: "இவள் பசலை நோய் கொண்டு நிறம் மாறினாள்" என்று ஊரார் சொல்வார்களே தவிர, "அவர் இவளை விட்டுப் பிரிந்து சென்றார்" என்று அவர் மேல் தவறு சொல்வார் யாரும் இல்லை.
explanation: The heroine laments the unfairness of the townspeople's gossip. They are quick to notice her pallor and blame her for not bearing the separation gracefully. However, no one points out the root cause of her suffering or blames the hero for abandoning her. The contrast between "என்பது அல்லால்" (other than saying) and "என்பார் இல்" (there is no one who says) highlights her isolation and the one-sided nature of society's judgment.
